aiClassified.method: deterministic rules; no model, no network

rules.aiTags: 13 non-exam tags assigned by rules over the whole pool and unioned with the Mini Test tags; #ImageBased/#GIFBased are objective (image present / GIF URL)
rules.examTags: QBank Hub Marrow PYQ exam_family only; #recentNEET/#AIIMS/#RecentUpdates are never assigned by the classifier
rules.fmge: tag evidence only; no FMGE question is emitted
rules.pyqExtras: subject + AI topic when placed (admitted for that subject/topic); otherwise the selected subject with ALL topics selected; inclusive tag match (ANY of its tags, including #recentNEET/#AIIMS, admits it)
rules.tagOnlyExtras: subject + AI topic when the classifier placed the question (admitted for that subject/topic); otherwise all 19 subjects in scope only, and only when its tag is selected
